speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Subacute Combined Degeneration of the spinal cord (likely due to Vitamin B12 deficiency) or a paraneoplastic syndrome such as Anti-Yo syndrome causing paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration and dementia. I will order tests to confirm.
